name: NASA daily satellite pictures
summary: Six daily pictures of Cyprus from NASA's GIBS: natural colours, night lights, dust and haze, ground heat, sea warmth and fires. They are pictures, not numbers.

el.name: Καθημερινές δορυφορικές εικόνες της NASA
el.summary: Έξι καθημερινές εικόνες της Κύπρου από το GIBS της NASA: φυσικά χρώματα, νυχτερινά φώτα, σκόνη και θολούρα, θερμότητα εδάφους, θάλασσα και φωτιές. Είναι εικόνες, όχι αριθμοί.

licence.attribution: Imagery provided by NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).

restrictions: NASA asks users of GIBS to show an acknowledgement; the full sentence is shown with every picture
NASA material must not be used to suggest that NASA endorses us
Data from outside NASA that NASA services carry follows its own licence

coverage.area: Cyprus and the sea around it

update.note: One picture a day per kind; the sea temperature is about a day and a half behind

quality.uncertainty: Pictures, not measurements at a school. One pixel is 250 m to 2 km wide, and clouds hide the ground, the sea and fires.
known_issues: A satellite passes Cyprus about once a day, so each picture is a daily mosaic, not a live view
Clouds hide the ground, the sea surface, dust and fires in most of these pictures
Ground heat is the temperature of the surface, not of the air; the sea map is a gap-filled analysis
Suomi NPP stopped sending new data on 2 Nov 2026 and Terra and Aqua are ageing, so NOAA-21 and NOAA-20 come first
Colours follow NASA's colour scales; the numbers on those scales are not shown here

upstream.name: NASA EOSDIS: VIIRS (NOAA-21, NOAA-20) and MODIS (Terra, Aqua) imagery
NASA JPL GHRSST MUR sea surface temperature analysis

use_for: Showing students what Cyprus looks like from space on a recent day
Seeing a dust cloud, smoke, a sea front or the glow of the cities
not_for: Any number at a school or in a street
Saying that a fire is out

notes: Layer ids come from NASA's own product lists and docs, not from the live service: the sandbox could not reach it. The full GIBS acknowledgement sentence (171 characters) is longer than the attribution field allows, so the pictures carry it. x_images lists what is fetched.
